messages.text: Signup ke turant baad paywall aa gaya, app kya karta hai wo samajhne se pehle hi.
Free trial option bhi dikha hoga na?
Haan par pehle app dekhne ko to mile, itna pressure kyun.
Hum feedback team ko bhej denge.
Competition mein cult.fit aisa nahi karta, free mein dikha deta hai.
